camel_example: aliyun hbr DescribeBackupJobs2 --region cn-hangzhou --Filters.1.Key VaultId --SortDirection DESCEND --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Filters.1.Operator IN --SourceType ECS_FILE --Filters.1.Values.1 COMPLETE --Edition STANDARD
description_en: Queries backup jobs that meet the specified criteria
description_zh: 查询一个或者多个符合条件的备份任务
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-backup-jobs-2 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-type ECS_FILE --sort-direction DESCEND --filters '[{"Operator":"IN","Values":["COMPLETE"],"Key":"VaultId"}]' --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupJobs2

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: Backs up Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files.

OSS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets.

NAS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud Apsara File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems.

OTS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud Tablestore instances.

UDM_ECS: Backs up entire ECS instances.

UDM_ECS_DISK: A sub-task for disk backup in an ECS instance backup job.

COMMON_NAS: A generic NAS data source. This includes archive NAS and on-premises NAS data sources. Use the Values parameter of Filters to specify the data source type.

File: Backs up on-premises files.

SYNC: Data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

ECS_FILE：备份ECS文件
OSS：备份阿里云OSS
NAS：备份阿里云NAS
OTS：备份阿里云OTS
UDM_ECS：备份ECS整机
UDM_ECS_DISK：ECS整机备份-云盘备份子任务
COMMON_NAS：通用NAS数据源，包括归档NAS数据源和本地NAS数据源。您需要通过Filters的Values区分数据源类型。
File：本地文件备份
SYNC：数据同步
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Valid values:

ASCEND: Ascending order.

DESCEND (Default): Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

ASCEND：升序
DESCEND（默认）：降序
parameters.name: sort_direction

fields.help_en:
The key of the filter. Valid values:

RegionId: The region ID.

PlanId: The backup plan ID.

JobId: The backup job ID.

VaultId: The repository ID.

InstanceId: The ECS instance ID.

Bucket: The name of the OSS bucket.

FileSystemId: The file system ID.

Status: The job status.

CreatedTime: The start time of the job.

CompleteTime: The end time of the job.

InstanceName: The name of the Tablestore instance.

BackupType: The backup job. This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to COMMON_NAS.

ParentId: The ID of the parent job. This parameter is required when you query sub-tasks. For example, if you set SourceType to UDM_ECS_DISK, you must specify the ID of the UDM_ECS job
fields.help_zh:
查询过滤器中的键值。取值包括：

RegionId：地域ID
PlanId：备份计划ID
JobId：备份任务ID
VaultId：仓库ID
InstanceId：ECS实例ID
Bucket：OSS bucket名称
FileSystemId：文件系统ID
Status：任务状态
CreatedTime：任务开始时间
CompleteTime：任务结束时间
InstanceName：表格存储实例名称
BackupType：备份任务（仅当 SourceType 取值为COMMON_NAS时，需要配置该参数）
ParentId： 查询子任务类型时，需要指定父类型任务的ID。 如：SourceType 取值为UDM_ECS_DISK时，需要指定UDM_ECS类型的任务ID
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The matching operator. The default value is IN. This parameter specifies the operator to use for matching the Key and Value. Valid values:

EQUAL: Equal to.

NOT_EQUAL: Not equal to.

GREATER_THAN: Greater than.

GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: Greater than or equal to.

LESS_THAN: Less than.

LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: Less than or equal to.

BETWEEN: The value is a JSON array in the format of `[start,end]`.

IN: The value is an array.

The IN operator is not supported when you use CompleteTime as the key for a query
fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。默认为IN。即过滤器中Key和Value支持的匹配操作（Operator）方式，取值包括：

EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
GREATER_THAN：大于
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL：大于等于
LESS_THAN：小于
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL：小于等于
BETWEEN：区间，value为JSON数组`[下届,上届]`。
IN：在集合中，value为数组。

当使用CompleteTime作为Key查询时，暂时不支持IN操作
fields.name: operator

parameters.help_en: The key-value pairs of the filter
parameters.name: filters

parameters.help_en: The edition. Valid values: BASIC and STANDARD. The default value is STANDARD
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition

BackupJob.description_en: The list of backup jobs that meet the specified criteria
BackupJob.description_zh: 符合条件的备份任务列表

items.description_en: The details of the backup job

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual data volume of the backup job after deduplication. Unit: bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 去除重复后备份任务实际数据量。单位为字节

ActualFiles.description_en: The actual number of processed files
ActualFiles.description_zh: 表示实际处理的文件数

ActualItems.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the actual number of items in the backup job
ActualItems.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示备份任务实际项目数

BackupType.description_en: The backup type. The value COMPLETE indicates a full backup
BackupType.description_zh: 备份类型。取值为COMPLETE，表示全量备份

Bucket.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to OSS. It indicates the name of the OSS bucket
Bucket.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，该参数有效。表示备份OSS bucket名称

BytesDone.description_en: The data volume of the incremental backup. Unit: bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 增量备份的数据量。单位为字节

BytesTotal.description_en: The total data volume of the data source. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 数据源总数据量。单位为字节

ChangeListPath.description_en: The configuration of the incremental file synchronization list. This parameter is required only for synchronization
ChangeListPath.description_zh: 增量文件同步列表的配置。（仅同步需要）

ClientId.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the ID of the backup client
ClientId.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示备份客户端ID

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the backup job was completed. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 备份任务完成时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CreateTime.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to NAS. It indicates the time when the file system was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，该参数有效。表示文件系统创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup job was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 备份任务创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CrossAccountRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role that is created in the source account for cross-account backup and managed by the current account
CrossAccountRoleName.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名

CrossAccountType.description_en:
The type of the cross-account backup. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Backs up data within the same account.

CROSS_ACCOUNT: Backs up data across accounts
CrossAccountType.description_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份

CrossAccountUserId.description_en: The ID of the source account that is managed by the current account for cross-account backup
CrossAccountUserId.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID

DestDataSourceDetail.description_en: The details of the destination data source. This parameter is required only for synchronization
DestDataSourceDetail.description_zh: 目的端数据源详情。（仅同步需要）

DestDataSourceId.description_en: The ID of the destination data source. This parameter is required only for synchronization
DestDataSourceId.description_zh: 目的端数据源ID。（仅同步需要）

DestSourceType.description_en: The type of the destination data source. This parameter is required only for synchronization
DestSourceType.description_zh: 目的端数据源类型。（仅同步需要）

Detail.description_en: The details of the ECS instance backup job

DestinationNativeSnapshotErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for the failed remote replication

DestinationNativeSnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the remote replication snapshot

DestinationNativeSnapshotProgress.description_en: The progress of the remote replication

DestinationNativeSnapshotStatus.description_en: The status of the remote replication

DestinationRetention.description_en: The retention period of the remote replication backup
DestinationRetention.description_zh: 异地复制备份保留时间

DestinationSnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the remote replication backup

DiskNativeSnapshotId.description_en: The mapping between snapshots and disks

DoCopy.description_en: Indicates whether a remote replication is performed

InstanceInfos.description_en: The information about the ECS instance, including the instance name and instance type
InstanceInfos.description_zh: ECS实例信息，包含ECS实例名称、实例规格等

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for the backup job

Exclude.description_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the path to files that do not need to be backed up. All files in this path are excluded. The path can be up to 255 characters long
Exclude.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示不需要进行备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都不备份。最多支持255个字符

FileSystemId.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to NAS. It indicates the file system ID
FileSystemId.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，该参数有效。表示文件系统ID

FilesDone.description_zh: 表示文件已处理完成数

FilesTotal.description_en: The total number of files to be processed
FilesTotal.description_zh: 表示需处理文件的总数

Identifier.description_en: This parameter is returned only when SourceType is set to CONTAINER. It indicates the ID of the cluster that is backed up by the container backup job. If the cluster is a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster, this parameter indicates the ACK cluster ID
Identifier.description_zh: 仅SourceType=CONTAINER时返回，表示容器备份任务备份的集群标识。当集群类型为阿里云容器服务Kubernetes集群时，该值为Kubernetes集群ID
Identifier.title_zh: 仅SourceType=CONTAINER时返回，表示容器备份任务备份的集群标识。当集群类型为阿里云容器服务Kubernetes集群时，该值为Kubernetes集群ID。

Include.description_en: The source paths included in the backup job
Include.description_zh: 备份任务包含的备份路径

InstanceId.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to NAS. It indicates the ECS instance ID
InstanceId.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，该参数有效。表示ECS实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the Tablestore instance

ItemsDone.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the number of backup items
ItemsDone.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示备份项目数

ItemsTotal.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the total number of items in the data source
ItemsTotal.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示数据源项目总数

JobName.description_en: The name of the backup job

Options.description_en:
This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates whether to use Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) to define the backup path.

This feature is available only for Windows ECS instances.

If data in the backup source is changed, set this parameter to `{"UseVSS":true}` to ensure data consistency between the backup and the source.

After you enable VSS, you cannot back up multiple file directories at the same time
Options.description_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示是否使用Windows系统VSS定义备份路径。

此功能仅支持Windows类型ECS实例。
如果备份源中有数据更改，需要确保备份数据与源数据的一致时，才可配置为`["UseVSS":true]`。
选择使用VSS后，不支持多个文件目录同时备份

OtsDetail.description_en: The details of the Tablestore instance

TableName.description_en: The list of data table names in the Tablestore instance
TableName.description_zh: 表格存储实例的数据表名称列表

items.description_en: The name of a data table in the Tablestore instance
items.description_zh: 表格存储实例的数据表名称

Path.description_en: The source path of the backup

Prefix.description_en: This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to OSS. It indicates the prefix of the backup object
Prefix.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，该参数有效。表示备份对象前缀

Progress.description_en: The backup progress. The value is calculated as 100% × 100

TotalFiles.description_en: The list of all files. This parameter is not returned for data synchronization
TotalFiles.description_zh: 所有的文件列表。（数据同步不返回该字段）

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: Backs up ECS files.

OSS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud OSS buckets.

NAS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud NAS file systems
SourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

ECS_FILE：备份ECS文件
OSS：备份阿里云OSS
NAS：备份阿里云NAS

Speed.description_en: The actual average backup speed. Unit: KB/s
Speed.description_zh: 实际的平均备份速度。单位为KB/s

SpeedLimit.description_en:
This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates the traffic shaping settings for the backup. The format is `{start}|{end}|{bandwidth}`. Use the `|` character to separate multiple traffic shaping configurations. The time ranges of the configurations cannot overlap.

start: The start hour.

end: The end hour.

bandwidth: The throttling speed. Unit: KB/s
SpeedLimit.description_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示备份流量控制。格式为`{start}|{end}|{bandwidth}`。多个流量控制配置使用`|`分隔，并且配置时间不允许有重叠。

start：起始小时
end：结束小时
bandwidth：限制速率，单位KB/s

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backup job started. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the backup job. Valid values:

COMPLETE: The job is successful.

PARTIAL_COMPLETE: The job is partially successful.

FAILED: The job failed
Status.description_zh:
备份任务状态。取值范围：

COMPLETE：成功
PARTIAL_COMPLETE：部分成功
FAILED：失败

TableName.description_en: The name of the data table in the Tablestore instance
TableName.description_zh: 表格存储实例的数据表名称

UpdatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup job was updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份任务更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup repository

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the request was successful, successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. The default value is 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of backup jobs that meet the specified criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的符合条件的备份任务总数
